tools.name: cleanapp_open
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to open CleanApp, report a real-world or digital problem, or browse the CleanApp miniapp. Do not use for household cleaning advice or computer disk-cleaning tasks.

tools.name: cleanapp_search_reports
tools.description: Use this when the user wants existing CleanApp observations about potholes, litter, illegal dumping, accessibility barriers, infrastructure damage, pollution, software bugs, scams or service problems. The brand need not be mentioned. Returns historical public reports, not an exhaustive or real-time

tools.name: cleanapp_prepare_report
tools.description: Prepare a factual physical or digital problem report from user-provided details. No report is submitted. Include optional source platform/URL, observation and source-publication times, reporter context or submitting AI client only when explicitly supplied; do not infer them from the affected product

tools.name: cleanapp_submit_report
tools.description: Use this only after the user approves the exact preview from cleanapp_prepare_report, including any source context and publication/notice permissions, and sending it to CleanApp. Permissions are frozen; do not upgrade them. tools.name: cleanapp_report_status
tools.description: Use this with the private tracking token supplied for the user’s submission. Distinguish intake received, AI analysis, decision/reason, publication and notice evidence. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "cleanapp_prepare_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
